response.overview: This film tells the story of Xia Xiaochuan, who dreams of becoming an actor and enters society for the first time, and strives to persevere while working hard on his own. When Xigua and Dongliang entered Xia Xiaochuan's life, Xia Xiaochuan fell into confusion. On one hand, he gave up his dream for the stability of life, and on the other hand, he struggled with the dream he had been pursuing in his heart. Xia Xiaochuan finally gave up love and chose to go out to work hard to realize his dream. effort. This confused time has become Xia Xiaochuan's memory, and it is also an unforgettable growth experience for Xia Xiaochuan.
